judgments.reason: The rules state the winner pays the bid and then receives a three-coin commission; nothing in the transcript or model claim that the commission is applied before payment to allow bids above available coins.
Commitments are described as sealed and private until the lot resolves; waiting does not reveal rival sealed bids according to the provided rules and observations.
The close action is defined to settle after all three lots are sold; the transcript shows close used after all lots were sold, so there is no evidence that close can settle with unauctioned lots.
The three-coin commission is explicitly given to the auction winner; catalog purchases are stated to be 'not auction wins,' and there is no evidence the commission applies to catalog buys.
